gold_answer: in the north-east of the country south of the Caspian Sea

answer:
Bandar-e Gaz County is located in **Golestan Province**, Iran.

Specifically, it is situated in the western part of Golestan Province, along the southeastern coast of the Caspian Sea. The county was established in 1997, and its capital is the city of Bandar-e Gaz itself.
